learnings: Tool errors (API failures, timeouts) should trigger automatic retry or fallback to another model rather than producing an inconclusive verdict that triggers expensive escalation audits

When one model fails due to a tool error and another succeeds on the same files, the successful review should be considered sufficient - escalation should only occur for genuine security uncertainty, not infrastructure failures
The audit tool should distinguish between 'inconclusive due to tool error' and 'inconclusive due to genuine security uncertainty' in its verdict logic
